clue.text: Milk producer gives us energy another way

indicators.note: arranging letters another way means the words us and energy are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dairy cow is praised for supplying us with energy by a different route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another way' signals the anagram of US ENERGY.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed of dairy cattle from the Channel Island is famous for rich creamy milk.

clue.text: Not fine — initially grey then wet

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word grey

parts.note: wet weather is rainy

explanation.surface: A weather report: not fine, at first grey, then wet.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse-textured, the opposite of fine-grained, as in a grainy photograph.

clue.text: Improve in hour after noon in Clapton?

indicators.note: after puts the hour abbreviation at the end, following the rest
in places the noon letter inside the guitarist's first name

parts.note: Eric Clapton, the rock guitarist

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether Clapton gets better in the hour after midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clapton' is a person here: Eric Clapton supplies ERIC.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something richer or better is to improve it, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Assassin from town in Japan

indicators.note: from tells us the letters are taken out of the run of words town in Japan

explanation.surface: A killer hails from a town in Japan.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese warrior trained in stealth, popularly pictured as a covert killer.

clue.text: Schoolboy son Baltic citizen expels

indicators.note: expels means the son letter is thrown out of the citizen word

parts.note: a citizen of Estonia, a Baltic state

explanation.surface: A schoolboy's son is expelled by a man from the Baltic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expels' fits a school setting, but it is the removal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil at Eton College, the famous English boarding school, is a schoolboy.

clue.text: Heated battles approaching sea

indicators.note: approaching puts the battles word just ahead of the sea word

parts.note: war is a series of battles
the Med is short for the Mediterranean Sea

explanation.surface: Fierce fighting draws near the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Made warm, raised in temperature: a plain synonym in past tense.

clue.text: Host on a march moving north

indicators.note: moving means the letters are shifted about into a new order

explanation.surface: An army host on a march heads north.
explanation.definitionFit: A news anchorman presents and hosts a broadcast.

clue.text: Route zero comes up through American state

indicators.note: through means the reversed zero goes into the middle of the state

parts.note: Maine, a state in New England

indicators.note: in a down clue, comes up means the letters are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: nil is zero

explanation.surface: A road number rises through an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: A principal railway line is a main route between cities.

clue.text: Fool takes plunge short time later

indicators.note: later sets the time word after the plunge word

parts.note: someone who takes a plunge dips
a tick is a moment

explanation.surface: A fool jumps in and only thinks a moment later.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal insult for an idiot, from the oil-gauge rod.

clue.text: Mr Toad an eccentric lacking definite plan

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so these letters go into a strange order

explanation.surface: Mr Toad of The Wind in the Willows is an eccentric with no fixed plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Done haphazardly, without method or aim, as with something chosen by chance.

clue.text: Economise seconds before squeeze

indicators.note: before puts the seconds letter ahead of the squeeze word

parts.note: to crimp is to pinch or press together

explanation.surface: Saving money means a quick squeeze on spending.
explanation.definitionFit: To be thrifty and spend as little as possible, as in scrimp and save.

clue.text: Star not totally conscientious foodie?

indicators.note: not totally means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a vegan, someone who eats on principle

explanation.surface: A celebrity is not quite a principled eater.
explanation.definitionFit: The brightest star in the constellation Lyra.

clue.text: Fruit, from tree, in can that needs a shake

indicators.note: shaking jumbles the contents, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Fruit picked from the tree goes into a tin that must be shaken.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned variety of peach is a stone fruit.

clue.text: Young head-turner?

parts.note: an owl can swivel its head almost all the way round, so a youngster of that bird is a young turner of heads

explanation.surface: An attractive young person turns heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head-turner' suggests a looker; it is literal, the bird that rotates its head.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby owl, the bird famous for rotating its head a long way.

clue.text: Kitchen heater tested with pair getting evicted

indicators.note: evicted means thrown out, so the pair letters are removed

parts.note: proven means tested and shown true

explanation.surface: A kitchen appliance is trialled while a couple are thrown out of their home.
explanation.definitionFit: The enclosed cooking appliance used for baking and roasting heats food.

clue.text: Wobble being unwell during leave

indicators.note: during puts the illness word inside the leave word

parts.note: to vacate is to leave
being unwell is being ill

explanation.surface: Someone falls sick while on leave and wavers.
explanation.definitionFit: To waver indecisively between options is to wobble figuratively.

clue.text: Annual account about chap in Los Angeles

indicators.note: about means the account letters go round the rest
in puts the chap inside the city letters

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A yearly report on a man living in Los Angeles.
explanation.definitionFit: An annual is a yearly publication, and this is a yearbook of dates and data.

clue.text: Sabotaged hunt okay to provide gift

indicators.note: something sabotaged is wrecked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hunt saboteurs disrupt a meet, hoping it goes well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gift' here is a token of gratitude, as in a little thank-you present.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, a small present given in gratitude is called this.

clue.text: Turn, then punch, producing shower of blows?

indicators.note: then puts the punch word after the turn word

parts.note: to wind is to turn
to sock is to punch

explanation.surface: A boxer twists and punches, raining blows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shower of blows' sounds like a flurry of punches; it is something that shows which way the wind blows.
explanation.definitionFit: The fabric cone at an airfield indicates where the breeze blows.

clue.text: In which clip round the ear might be necessary?

definitions.text: In which clip round the ear might be necessary?

parts.words: In which clip round the ear might be necessary?
parts.note: a clip round the ear is a smack, but here scissors literally clip the hair around the ears

explanation.surface: A naughty child might need a smack on the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clip round the ear' is British slang for a light cuff on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A visit to the barber involves trimming hair, including around the ears.

clue.text: Sentimental sports supporter keeping wicket

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the wicket letter sits inside

parts.note: a golf tee supports the ball
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: A soppy fan holds on to a cricket wicket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sports supporter' suggests a fan; it is the golf peg.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessively dainty or quaint, in a cloying, mawkish way.

clue.text: Stole material from gym in Knightsbridge

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the words gym in Knightsbridge

explanation.surface: Clothing was stolen from a gym in an upmarket London district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stole' looks like a verb of theft; it is the fur wrap. Knightsbridge is a wealthy area of London.
explanation.definitionFit: A stole is a fur wrap, and the fur of this weasel-like animal is a luxury.

clue.text: Genius? Most are nuts

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A cynic suggests most geniuses are mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliant master, especially of music, is hailed as a virtuoso.

clue.text: Artist captures alien in part one needs to see

indicators.note: captures means the artist letters hold the rest inside

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
ET is the film alien

explanation.surface: A painter takes in an extraterrestrial for a role.
explanation.definitionFit: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye is essential for sight.

clue.text: Habit of socially inept person

definitions.meaning: a habit is a garment, here a hooded weatherproof jacket
a nerdish obsessive, from the jackets worn by trainspotters

explanation.definitionFit: Both a waterproof hooded coat and slang for an obsessive nerd.

clue.text: In Netherlands notice American tennis star

indicators.note: In puts the notice and the American letter inside the country letters

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands
an ad is a notice

explanation.surface: A tennis star is spotted in the Netherlands by an American.
explanation.definitionFit: Rafael Nadal, the Spanish champion with many French Open titles.

clue.text: Ivy for one always jealous

parts.note: ever means always
green with envy, jealous

explanation.surface: Someone called Ivy is forever envious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ivy' reads as a woman's name; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy keeps its leaves all year, an example of a plant of that kind.

clue.text: Chinese people coming into Georgia's country

indicators.note: coming into puts the people inside the state letters

parts.note: GA is the abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
the Han are the majority ethnic group of China

explanation.surface: Chinese migrants arrive in Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: A West African nation, formerly the Gold Coast.

clue.text: Freeholder in the old sultanate

parts.note: ye is an old form of the
Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A landowner lives in an old Arabian sultanate.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a man owning a small landed estate, a farmer holding land in freehold.

clue.text: Dries out, drinking tea, more sober

indicators.note: drinking means taking in, so the tea goes inside
out means disordered, so the letters of dries are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone sobering up dries out while sipping tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' turns DRIES into SDIER, and 'drinking' puts TEA into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Steadier means less unsteady, as a drinker becomes when sobering.

clue.text: Service charges for castle in the air?

parts.note: something in the air is up
a keep is the main tower of a castle

explanation.surface: Fees for a castle in the air, an unrealistic dream.
explanation.walkthrough: A castle in the air is a pipe dream; here a castle word goes after the up word.
explanation.definitionFit: Maintenance costs, the money spent keeping property in repair.

clue.text: Male, no dove, carrying a weapon

indicators.note: carrying means the male word bears the a along with it, next to it

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
a hawk is the opposite of a dove in politics, someone warlike

explanation.surface: A man who is no pacifist carries a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A light axe used by Native Americans as a tool and weapon.
